newsitem.title: ITALY: Reno De Medici 9-mth sales off, profit up.
newsitem.headline: Reno De Medici 9-mth sales off, profit up.

text.p: Italian cardboard maker Reno De Medici reported a fall in nine month 1996 sales due to a decline in prices, but net profits still showed a rise.

The company, listed on the Milan bourse since July, said net sales in the January to September period fell by 16 percent to 186.2 billion lire from 221.5 billion lire, while net profits rose to 10.5 billion lire from 4.7 billion or up 123 percent.
The gross operation margin rose by 16.6 percent to 35.7 billion lire from 30.6 billion lire.
The company is also to ask an extraordinary meeting of its shareholders to launch a convertible bond for the next stage of development of the company.
